content: Always check Integration Matrix before scheduling cross-department releases
Shared environments (especially FIN-TEST-01, IT-TEST-01, INTEG-01) require advance booking
Critical Integration Paths require coordinated testing across all connected systems
Month-end, Quarter-end, and Year-end are high-risk periods - minimize changes
Security systems (PATH-006, PATH-007) require 24/7 availability - schedule carefully
SAP S/4HANA is the central hub - any SAP changes impact multiple departments
